verdict.rationale: Penpot documents AI workflow automation through its MCP server, a plugin API, an RPC API with access tokens, and event-triggered outbound webhooks. Nothing in the evidence shows a native way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Webhooks fire on one-off events and the API is a developer building block, so neither counts as recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
